description_en: Calls SendCustomMessageToAll to send a custom message to all online members in a room
description_zh: 调用SendCustomMessageToAll向房间中全部在线成员发送自定义消息
kebab_example: aliyun imp send-custom-message-to-all --app-id 7m000q --room-id AE35-0000-T95F --biz-body Hello,_World --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendCustomMessageToAll

parameters.help_en: The user's application ID, generated when creating an application in the console. Contains lowercase letters and digits, with a length of 6 characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the room, returned when calling CreateRoom
parameters.help_zh: 房间的唯一标识，在调用CreateRoom时返回
parameters.name: room_id

parameters.help_en: The content of the custom message body, with a maximum size of 2048 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 自定义消息体的内容，大小不超过2048个字节
parameters.name: body
